div.div:
LACP SPECIFICATION (IEEE 802.1AX)
• Protocol Standard: IEEE 802.1AX (formerly 802.3ad).
• Bundling Capacity: 2x 100Mbps FastEthernet per bundle (200Mbps aggregate).
• Active Negotiation: Both ends configured in channel-group X mode active.
• Load Balancing: Source-Destination MAC address hashing (src-dst-mac).
• Failover Continuity: Single-member failure; bundle remains operational without drop.

text.tspan: • Active Negotiation: Both ends configured in channel-group X mode
• Load Balancing: Source-Destination MAC address hashing
• Failover Continuity: Single-member failure; bundle remains

div.div:
RAPID-PVST+ REDUNDANCY MODEL
• Convergence Protocol: Rapid Per-VLAN Spanning Tree Plus.
• Root Bridge Priority: Core 1 Primary (4096) / Core 2 Standby (8192).
• Edge Protection: PortFast & BPDU Guard enabled on host access ports.
• Uplink Failover: Rapid PVST+ designed for rapid convergence on core uplink disruption.
• Loop Prevention: Inter-core trunk Po10 maintains loop-free forwarding topology.

text.tspan: • Convergence Protocol: Rapid Per-VLAN Spanning Tree Plus.

div.div:
CHANGE-001 HA AUDIT SUMMARY
• Re-anchored Node: ACC-F2-01 uplink bundle verified on Po2.
• Port-Security Status: Sticky MAC active on ACC-F2-01:Fa0/1.
• Cross-VLAN Routing: Verified via Core 1 Centralized SVIs (10.10.10.1).
• Physical As-Built: Patch lead routed to Floor 2 Cat6 Field Termination.
